system.description: Target name this connection serves (the publish_report target qualifier), e.g. powerbi.

tenant_id.description: Entra directory (tenant) id the service principal lives in.

client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration (not the object id).

workspace_id.description: Power BI workspace (group) id the SP is a Member of; every model and report this connection delivers lands here (RA-10 scope boundary).

client_secret_env.description: Set by the RUNNER at job time (J-4 credential injection); never written into a registration file.

api_base_override.description: FIXTURE ONLY: host replacement for the pinned Power BI API base. The pinned path shape still applies; live registrations omit this.

login_base_override.description: FIXTURE ONLY: host replacement for the pinned Entra login base.

fabric_base_override.description: FIXTURE ONLY: host replacement for the pinned Fabric API base.
